subject: Decoupling JSON python tests from Bloom. Now using valkey-test-framework (#52)
reason: The change is a build/CI and test-infrastructure refactor only: CMakeLists.txt swaps the valkey-bloom test dependency for valkey-test-framework, and the Python integration tests (json_test_case.py, test_json_basic.py, test_rdb.py) are converted from setup methods to pytest fixtures. No module source code, command behaviour, replies, persistence or configuration handling is touched, so the loaded valkey-json module is behaviourally identical on both builds and there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
